guarantees: Worker-owned parent and found-child handles remain alive; immutable captured observations are separate from live handles. Refresh uses the same held directory after pathname replacement.
Component budget checked before name copy/validation; exact native units, no display transport, case folding, pathname join or process-cwd change.
Location/length, native lookup and found metadata failures are separate. Missing retains evidence and does not reserve a name or authorize creation.
Mismatched/unknown lookup contexts fail rather than becoming absence; raw context consistency is not semantic identity proof.
Cancellation between native calls returns Unknown/InterruptedRead entry_probe.cancelled and no partial record; private handles release. Exceptions unwind without retry.
limitations: No native-call interruption, snapshot, implicit provider hydration guarantee, global resource quota, UI-safe owner retirement or mutation authority.
Probe does not complete operation capabilities, alias/descendant detection, planned-name equivalence/collision grouping, frozen inventories, loss consent or execution-time revalidation.
Linux qualification proves ASCII casefold lookup on a private ext4 image, not every Unicode/filesystem rule.
Directory labels/navigation path binding, worker scheduling, large indexes, selected-entry refresh integration and remaining inventories still require implementation. WP-01 remains open.
validation_notes: Final common 95-file manifest matched local and remote source; 35 suites passed per host, 244/242/248 cases.

Initial seven-step builds included CMake regeneration and one production unit plus affected/new fixtures. Mac configure/generate 3.5/.1 seconds; total 6.222 seconds. Final reviewed six-step builds recompiled probe and its two fixtures, relinked library and both test executables: 2.655/5.707/12.981 seconds on Mac/Linux/Windows.
Review changed the factory input from value to const reference and moved size checks before validation/copy; all host and sanitizer validations repeated after the change.

Fresh direct sanitizer builds instrument all listed units, no reused objects. Final Mac/Windows durations 44.833/64.181 seconds versus pre-review same-scope 38.998/66.5221052; exact flags, source lists/hashes and emitted Windows unit names verified. Elapsed time alone was not freshness evidence.

Linux sanitized required-casefold image build 87.946 seconds, test .034 versus pre-review same-scope 87.782/.032. Exact compiler command, source hashes, flags, native results, image mount and cleanup evidence retained.

Both Linux private 64 MiB images unmounted and loop audits empty before image/diagnostic removal; final remote audit confirms workspaces absent, fixtures empty and no owned test executable live. Mac/Windows diagnostics hashed and zero-owner checks recorded before disposal; normal verified builds retained.
Windows development outputs and temporary variables remained on V:. No GUI or production mutation was added.
